title: Controlled Insomnia
description: Makes phantoms only spawn when you want them to.
body:
![Controlled Insomnia](https://codeberg.org/HexagonNico/ControlledInsomnia/media/branch/1.21.1/common/src/main/resources/title.png)

Makes phantoms only spawn when you want them to.

## About

**Controlled Insomnia** changes the spawning of phantoms to make sure they only spawn when you want them to.

Phantoms now only spawn when the player has the **Insomnia** effect applied.
A **Potion of Insomnia** can be brewed with an eye blossom or an eye of ender depending on the version of Minecraft.

When a player has the Insomnia effect, they will not be able to sleep in a bed and phantoms will spawn around them following the same vanilla rules.
Phantoms spawn in the sky at night every 1-2 minutes around players with Insomnia.
